ex: A large-format centella ampoule with probiotics.
d: Skin that reacts and breaks out at the same time usually has an unsettled microbiome, which is what the probiotic ferment is for.
At 95 ml this is built for daily use on the whole face rather than saved for bad days.

n: Vitamin C Glutathione Skin Booster Mist
ex: A facial mist that actually carries actives.
d: Most mists are water with a scent. This one carries vitamin C and glutathione, so the step does something beyond feeling nice.
Use it over makeup through the day, or as the first layer on bare skin.

ex: 10% azelaic acid for oily, congested skin.
d: Azelaic acid works on spots, redness and the marks left behind, which makes it the efficient choice when skin is doing all three.
At 10% it is a serious dose, buffered with panthenol so it stays usable daily.
caution: Introduce slowly. Wear sunscreen every day while using it.

ex: Rose PDRN and visible collagen shots, for bounce.
d: PDRN for repair and collagen for structure, suspended as visible capsules so the actives stay intact until use.
The plumping shows up within days; the firmness takes a few weeks.

ex: A PDRN eye serum in a cooling metal tip.
d: The eye area thins and creases before the rest of the face, and PDRN is the repair ingredient usually reserved for clinic work.
The metal applicator is cold on contact, which helps with morning puffiness.

n: Kojic Acid Turmeric Vita Eye Gel Serum
ex: The kojic acid line, formulated for the eye area.
d: Dark circles are partly pigment, which is why the brightening range extends to an eye product at all.
Caffeine handles the puffiness; the gel texture keeps it light enough not to migrate.

ex: 0.1% retinol with nine peptides behind it.
d: A sensible retinol strength paired with a peptide complex, so the firming works from two directions at once.
Panthenol takes the edge off the adjustment weeks.
caution: Night use only. Start two nights a week and wear sunscreen daily.

ex: A tranexamic acid booster for face and eye.
d: Tranexamic acid is what dermatologists reach for when niacinamide alone stops shifting a mark.
Formulated gently enough to take right up to the eye, which saves a separate product.

ex: Plant-derived collagen for the eye area.
d: Vegan collagen does the same structural job without an animal source, which is the whole point of the AXIS-Y range.
Light enough to wear under concealer without creasing.

ex: Two brightening ingredients, formulated for under the eye.
d: Dark circles that are pigment rather than shadow need pigment ingredients, and these are the two with the best evidence short of prescription.
A cream rather than a serum, so it carries the area through the night.

ex: Probiotic centella, in an eye cream with a metal tip.
d: The eye version of the Probio-Cica line, for skin too reactive for a standard eye treatment.
The cooling applicator does as much for morning puffiness as the formula does.

ex: NAD+ and retinal together, for the eye area.
d: Retinal acts faster than retinol, and pairing it with NAD+ and thirty peptides is numbuzin's most serious anti-ageing formula.
Built for the eye area specifically, so the strength is calibrated for thin skin.
caution: Night use only. Build up slowly and wear sunscreen every morning.

ex: A retinal booster for face and eye, with caffeine.
d: Retinal converts in one step rather than two, so results on texture arrive sooner than with retinol.
Formulated to be safe around the eye, which most retinal products are not.
caution: Night use only. Introduce gradually and wear sunscreen every day.

ex: Three heavyweight actives in one toning booster.
d: 6% tranexamic acid, 10% niacinamide and retinal is an unusually direct formula - close to what you would otherwise layer from three bottles.
For skin that has already got used to actives and stopped seeing change.
caution: Not a starting point. Night use, patch test first, and sunscreen every day.

ex: A gentle at-home peel from the kojic acid line.
d: Exfoliating care, clarifying care and brightening care in one bottle, which is how the label itself breaks it down.
A peel in the Korean sense: regular and gentle, rather than one aggressive session.
caution: Contains exfoliating acids. Use at night and wear sunscreen daily.

ex: Six peptides in a 150 ml bottle meant to be used freely.
d: Most peptide serums come in 30 ml and get rationed. At 150 ml this one is built to be used on the neck and chest too.
Works on tone, texture, pores and oil at once rather than specialising.

ex: Vitamin C with E and ferulic acid, the way it works best.
d: Vitamin C is more stable and more effective alongside vitamin E and ferulic acid, which is the combination here.
Brightening, smoothing and anti-pigment, for all skin types.
caution: Use in the morning under sunscreen, and keep the bottle out of the light.

ex: 70.8% birch sap, and not a drop of oil.
d: Oily skin still gets dehydrated, and most moisturisers answer that with oils it does not need. This one answers it with birch sap instead.
Thin, fast and calming, and it layers under sunscreen without pilling.

n: Firming & Lifting Retinol Flat Iron Eye Roller
ex: A retinol eye treatment with a flat metal applicator.
d: The flat iron tip is the point: it presses the product along the line rather than dragging across thin skin.
Retinol for the crease, centella and panthenol so the area tolerates it.
caution: Night use only. Start twice a week and wear sunscreen daily.

ex: TECA, the concentrated form of centella, in a daily cream.
d: TECA is centella reduced to its active fractions, so it does more per application than a plain extract.
The cream to use when skin has been pushed too far by actives or sun.

n: 5+ Vitamin Glutathione Dark Spot Laser Cream
ex: The brightening number of the range, as a night cream.
d: Glutathione and vitamin C are the two ingredients people usually chase in a supplement; here they are where you can see them working.
A cream rather than a serum, so the actives stay against the skin overnight.
caution: Wear sunscreen daily, or the marks come back.

ex: The firming cream in the centella line.
d: Hyaluronic acid plumps immediately while TECA works on firmness over the following weeks.
Rich without being heavy, and it sits well as the last step at night.

ex: Centella and a five-peptide complex in a small concentrate jar.
d: A concentrate rather than a daily cream: a small jar, used sparingly, on the areas that need firming.
Centella keeps it calm enough for sensitive skin to tolerate the peptides.
flag: Brand is not printed on the jar or legible on the carton. Confirm before publishing.

n: Visibly Firming Collagen + Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream
ex: A firming cream with a gua sha applicator built into the cap.
d: Collagen and retinol for the firming, and a sculpting tip so the massage is part of the routine rather than an extra step.
Refining rather than rich, so it suits most skin types.
caution: Contains retinol. Use at night and wear sunscreen daily.

ex: The plainest centella cream in the range, and the most reordered.
d: Pure centella from Madagascar and very little else, which is exactly what reactive skin wants.
The cream to keep for the weeks after a reaction, or after too much sun.

ex: PDRN and peptides, with 5% niacinamide for the eye area.
d: The pink line's eye cream, with a higher niacinamide dose than most eye products carry.
Plumps the crease and works on the darkness at the same time.

ex: A targeted cream for stubborn pigment.
d: Tranexamic acid with niacinamide and a little glycolic acid, which is close to what a clinic would prescribe for melasma-type marks.
A small 20 g tube, because it is meant for the patches rather than the whole face.
caution: Daily sunscreen is essential while using it.

ex: The Madeca cream, from the lab that patented madecassoside.
d: Centellian24 hold the dermatological heritage behind madecassoside, and the Madeca cream is the product that line is known for.
Time Reverse is the firming version, aimed at lines rather than redness.

ex: A brightening daily cream for all skin types.
d: Vitamin C and niacinamide for the tone, hyaluronic acid for the moisture, in a cream light enough for daily wear.
Pairs with the Vitamin C serum from the same line.

n: 3+ Azelaic Acid + Cica Skin Soothing Moisturizer
ex: Azelaic acid in a moisturiser, for red and bumpy skin.
d: Getting azelaic acid into the moisturising step means it stays on the skin for the whole night rather than one thin layer.
Cica keeps the formula calm, which is what makes it tolerable daily.
caution: Introduce gradually and wear sunscreen daily.

n: Ground Rice and Honey Glow Mask
ex: Ground rice and honey, the old Korean brightening mask.
d: Rice and honey were the court recipe for dull skin long before any of this was an industry, and Beauty of Joseon have simply kept it.
Gentle enough to use twice a week, and it leaves skin soft rather than tight.

ex: 30% clay with three acids, aimed at blackheads.
d: Clay pulls the oil out while AHA, BHA and PHA loosen what is stuck in the pore - more effective together than either alone.
Use it on the T-zone twice a week rather than over the whole face.
caution: Contains exfoliating acids. Wear sunscreen daily.

n: Kojic Acid Turmeric Night Wrapping Mask
ex: The dark spot line's overnight wrapping mask.
d: Pigment ingredients want long contact, and a wrapping mask is the only way to get eight hours of it without losing half to the pillow.
Rinse in the morning; the change shows up over weeks.

ex: A 100% plant-oil bar with honey and chamomile.
d: An intensively nourishing bar, made on plant oil rather than detergent, for skin that itches or flakes after washing.
Suited to ageing and dry skin, and gentle enough for daily use.

ex: An alpha arbutin cleansing bar for uneven tone.
d: Alpha arbutin is one of the gentler pigment ingredients, which makes it workable in a bar used over larger areas.
Lather, leave it a moment, then rinse.
caution: Wear sunscreen on exposed areas while using brightening products.
